notes: Names printed without suffix (BRASHEARS, ADELAIDE, ARLINGTON, SASSAFRAS, COMFORT) recorded as '... Street'. The street at y~4250 is printed MARQUIS (Not Open) west of Colerain and AV just east of Colerain, so it is recorded as Marquis Avenue on both sides; the volume 6 key map labels the east part ERIE (AV.). Colerain Av. is 60 ft and curves through the sheet (slope ~0.165 Brashears-Marquis, ~0.10 Marquis-y6360, N-S below). Sassafras runs east past Comfort to the sheet edge (x~6500) beside the canal without meeting another street. West of x~400 (the A-B join line) the sheet overlaps 601. Bridge ROAD at the top right runs ENE off the top edge toward the Ludlow Ave. Dairy Farm; no other street on it here. Brashears width not printed on this sheet.
